blurb: Portola Valley Training Center is located on 60 acres with multiple arenas, a 5/8 mile racetrack, and 40 acres of trails. It offers English, Western, and Carriage Driving lessons, summer camps for children, and hosts world-class trainers and horses. The facility includes hot and cold wash racks, feedings, and stall cleaning twice daily.
